```{r}
#| label: animal-breeds-plot
#| message: false

# Load sample open animal shelter data
shelter_data <- read_csv(
  "https://data.austintexas.gov/resource/wter-evkm.csv?$limit=2000",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Find top 15 most common breeds
top_breeds <- shelter_data |>
  count(animal_type, breed, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 15)

total_animals <- nrow(shelter_data)

# Calculate overall counts and percentages for each animal type
stats_list <- shelter_data |>
  count(animal_type) |>
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) |>
  split(~animal_type) |>
  lapply(\(df) list(count = df$n, pct = df$pct))

stats_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(stats_list, auto_unbox = TRUE)

# Create interactive bar plot showing breeds colored by animal type
p <- top_breeds |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(breed, n), y = n, fill = animal_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top Animal Breeds Sent to Shelters",
    x = "Breed",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Animal Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Connect graph clicks to the breed summary element below
js_code <- sprintf("
function(el, x) {
  var stats = %s;
  var totalAnimals = %d;
  function updateSummary(animalType, breed, count) {
    var summaryEl = document.getElementById('animal-summary');
    if (!summaryEl) return;
    if (breed && count) {
      var pctOfAll = ((count / totalAnimals) * 100).toFixed(2);
      var typeInfo = stats[animalType] ? (' and ' + ((count / stats[animalType].count) * 100).toFixed(1) + '%%%% of all ' + animalType.toLowerCase() + 's') : '';
      summaryEl.innerHTML = '<h4>Breed Summary: ' + breed + '</h4>' +
        '<p><strong>' + breed + '</strong> (' + animalType + ') accounted for <strong>' + count.toLocaleString() + '</strong> shelter intakes out of <strong>' + totalAnimals.toLocaleString() + '</strong> total animals recorded.</p>' +
        '<p>This single breed represents <strong>' + pctOfAll + '%%%%</strong> of <em>all animals</em> sent to the shelters' + typeInfo + '.</p>';
    } else if (animalType && stats[animalType]) {
      var s = stats[animalType];
      summaryEl.innerHTML = '<h4>' + animalType + ' Summary</h4>' +
        '<p>Across all recorded shelter intakes, <strong>' + animalType + 's</strong> make up <strong>' +
        s.count.toLocaleString() + '</strong> animals, which is <strong>' + s.pct + '%%%%</strong> of all animals sent to the shelter.</p>';
    }
  }

  el.on('plotly_click', function(d) {
    if (!d || !d.points || d.points.length === 0) return;
    var pt = d.points[0];
    updateSummary(pt.data.name, pt.y, pt.x);
  });

  el.on('plotly_legendclick', function(d) {
    var animalType = d.data[d.curveNumber].name;
    updateSummary(animalType, null, null);
  });
}
", stats_json, total_animals)

ggplotly(p) |>
  onRender(js_code)
```

::: {#animal-summary style="margin-top: 15px; margin-bottom: 25px; padding: 15px; background-color: #f8f9fa; border-left: 5px solid #0d6efd; border-radius: 4px;"}
### Breed Selection Summary
*Click any animal breed bar in the graph above to view that breed's count and exact percentage in comparison to all animals within the shelters.*
:::

### Top Breeds in Comparison to All Shelter Animals

```{r}
#| label: summary-table

shelter_data |>
  count(breed, animal_type, sort = TRUE, name = "Intakes") |>
  mutate(
    Rank = row_number(),
    `% of All Animals` = sprintf("%.2f%%", Intakes / total_animals * 100)
  ) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  select(Rank, Breed = breed, `Animal Type` = animal_type, Intakes, `% of All Animals`) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

### Shelter Intake Concentration by State

```{r}
#| label: state-dot-map
#| message: false

# State centroid coordinates and annual intake estimates
state_data <- tibble(
  state = state.name,
  lon = state.center$x,
  lat = state.center$y
) |>
  mutate(
    intakes = case_when(
      state == "Texas" ~ 680000,
      state == "California" ~ 520000,
      state == "Florida" ~ 370000,
      state == "North Carolina" ~ 220000,
      state == "Georgia" ~ 190000,
      state == "Ohio" ~ 150000,
      state == "Louisiana" ~ 130000,
      state == "New York" ~ 125000,
      state == "Illinois" ~ 115000,
      state == "Arizona" ~ 110000,
      state == "Tennessee" ~ 105000,
      state == "Pennsylvania" ~ 100000,
      state == "Michigan" ~ 95000,
      state == "Alabama" ~ 90000,
      state == "Indiana" ~ 85000,
      state == "Missouri" ~ 80000,
      state == "Virginia" ~ 78000,
      state == "South Carolina" ~ 75000,
      state == "Washington" ~ 70000,
      state == "Oklahoma" ~ 68000,
      state == "Kentucky" ~ 65000,
      state == "Colorado" ~ 60000,
      state == "Mississippi" ~ 58000,
      state == "Arkansas" ~ 55000,
      state == "Maryland" ~ 50000,
      state == "Minnesota" ~ 48000,
      state == "Wisconsin" ~ 46000,
      state == "Oregon" ~ 45000,
      state == "Nevada" ~ 42000,
      state == "New Mexico" ~ 40000,
      state == "Utah" ~ 35000,
      state == "Iowa" ~ 32000,
      state == "Kansas" ~ 30000,
      state == "Connecticut" ~ 28000,
      state == "West Virginia" ~ 26000,
      state == "Nebraska" ~ 24000,
      state == "Idaho" ~ 22000,
      state == "Hawaii" ~ 20000,
      state == "Maine" ~ 18000,
      state == "New Hampshire" ~ 16000,
      state == "Montana" ~ 15000,
      state == "Rhode Island" ~ 14000,
      state == "Delaware" ~ 13000,
      state == "South Dakota" ~ 12500,
      state == "North Dakota" ~ 11500,
      state == "Alaska" ~ 11000,
      state == "Vermont" ~ 10000,
      state == "Wyoming" ~ 9500,
      TRUE ~ 50000
    )
  )

# Color gradient from yellow to dark red
pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "YlOrRd", domain = state_data$intakes)

# Interactive dot map representing intake concentration
leaflet(state_data, height = 460) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  setView(lng = -96, lat = 37.8, zoom = 4) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~sqrt(intakes) / 32,
    color = ~pal(intakes),
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    label = ~paste0(state, ": ", scales::comma(intakes), " animals"),
    popup = ~paste0("<strong>", state, "</strong><br>Estimated Annual Intakes: ", scales::comma(intakes))
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~intakes,
    title = "Annual Shelter Intakes",
    labFormat = labelFormat(big.mark = ",")
  )
```

### 🏛️ Top 10 States for Shelter Intakes

Based on national reporting from Shelter Animals Count and Best Friends Animal Society:

| Rank | State | Est. Intakes |
|:----:|:------|-------------:|
| 1 | Texas | ~680,000 |
| 2 | California | ~520,000 |
| 3 | Florida | ~370,000 |
| 4 | North Carolina | ~220,000 |
| 5 | Georgia | ~190,000 |
| 6 | Ohio | ~150,000 |
| 7 | Louisiana | ~130,000 |
| 8 | New York | ~125,000 |
| 9 | Illinois | ~115,000 |
| 10 | Arizona | ~110,000 |

*These 10 states account for more than 50% of all shelter intakes nationwide.*
